name: Check Point Certified Security Master Elite

third_party_evaluations.summary: Top-tier Check Point credential requiring CCSM plus advanced ISA specializations.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded CCSM-plus-specializations pathway and explicit senior scope support expert responsibility within the Check Point estate; vendor dependence limits transfer to broader enterprise architecture.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The stored requirement for CCSM plus advanced specializations and senior-scope factors supports expert depth within Check Point. The record does not specify a practical exam, so I would still validate hands-on skills before a senior MSSP hire.

alex-novak.rationale: Advanced specializations and the recorded senior-scope factor indicate substantial Check Point expertise. With five years and only an unspecified proctored assessment documented, I retain professional rather than infer cross-domain expert capability.
